newsitem.title: GERMANY: Viag-mobile network to start on time in summer '98.
newsitem.headline: Viag-mobile network to start on time in summer '98.

text.p: Maximilian Ardelt, management board member of German diversified utility Viag, said on Wednesday that the company's E2 mobile phone network would start as planned in the summer of 1998, and not earlier.

Ardelt said the date had been known for a long time adding that Viag had never said that the E2 network would kick off at the beginning of 1998. Speculation about problems to the system or delays were without any foundation, Ardelt said.
The E2 will be operated by Viag Intercom, a 50-50 joint venture between Viag and British telecommunications group British Telecom.

Ardelt also said that the alliance with British Telecom was solid. "We have had this agreement for the past two years. Both partners are sticking by it," said Ardelt, speaking at the CeBIT electronics trade fair in Hanover.
